name: std::priority_queue<T,Container,Compare>::emplace

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
args

 -

 arguments to forward to the constructor of the element

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Logarithmic number of comparisons plus the complexity of Container::emplace_back.

summary: Pushes a new element to the priority queue. The element is constructed in-place, i.e. no copy or move operations are performed. The constructor of the element is called with exactly the same arguments as supplied to the function.
